anchor.meaning: Enemy body centre. Draw each frame with this pixel on the enemy position (e.x, e.y).

scaleRule: drawScale = LST.StatusLook.bodyR(e) / refBodyR (world units per sheet px); i.e. draw the frame at frame.w * bodyR/88 world units wide. Same art for every enemy type, no tint.

shellBottom.meaning: lowest opaque row of the hold frame (round ice shell, plus icicles/bumps if any)

alpha: shell fill is see-through (about 50% alpha); ink, snow and glint are solid

provenance.postProcess: _tools/process_v011.py build_ice (key bg, un-mix, see-through alpha by colour class, 2x2 cells, scale x0.6113 so the round shell is 220 px wide (<= 2.5*refBodyR, largest with no cell clipping), shell centre on anchor, other frames registered to it by ink cross-correlation; snap = generated frames 0,1,3, main = frame 3)
provenance.license: Original generated art made for Brian Awsumb's Last Stand Tower; no third-party packs or licensed sheets.
provenance.prompt: 2x2 on flat crimson-magenta; same ice style as the v0.1.0 pick (ref ice_a.jpg: see-through cyan fill, navy ink, white rim, glints, snow cap with wavy drip edge); shell is a perfect ROUND circle; outline+frost rim / half filled / full shell / full shell + snow cap hugging the top curve (final).
